name: Competitor Price Monitor (Scrape → Compare → Email Digest)

parameters.content:
## Competitor Price Monitor
Every morning it scrapes competitor product pages, compares prices with yesterday and emails a digest **only when something changed** (or a page broke).

- Handles `$1,299.99`, `1.299,99 €`, `₩12,900`
- Per-product change threshold
- Remembers prices in workflow static data — no database needed

_Activate the workflow: static data is only saved on production runs._
